lines: 🎙️ Warned both of them before the podcast dropped. Awkward calls, no ambush
🧒 Brought the gate regulars inside to watch a full session. The kid told him he could not sleep the night before
🧊 Cancelled the cryo chamber and did up the family house instead. Recovered better anyway
